title: Decide where marketing waitlist and contact intake lives before the production cutover
description:
## Plan step 5 (gates production cutover, not the merge)
chattic.us /api* proxies to the legacy production thin-turn Lambda Function URL and serves POST /api/waitlist/survey, /api/waitlist/confirm, /api/waitlist/invite and /api/contact. The TypeScript control plane does not implement them. When legacy production thin-turn is replaced, signups and contact submissions fail. Options: a small Lambda in the website repo reading and writing the existing WAITLIST and CONTACT items in the Messaging table, or a bounded bridge keeping legacy thin-turn only for those routes.
## Decision: D4. Related: chatticus-574e4b, chatticus-8912d6.
## Acceptance
- The chosen option is recorded and built; waitlist and contact submissions succeed with legacy production thin-turn removed (verified on staging first).
Source: docs/PROMOTE_TO_MAIN.md (PR 534, branch ts/promote-to-main-plan). Nothing has been executed; owner decisions are in the 'Decisions needed from the owner' ticket.

comments.author: home
comments.text: D4 decided: recommendation recorded, to be built later. Marketing waitlist and contact intake moves off legacy production thin-turn to a small Lambda in the website repo reading and writing the existing WAITLIST and CONTACT items in the legacy Messaging table (a bounded bridge to legacy thin-turn only if unavoidable). Gates the production cutover, not the merge. D5 note: legacy production Messaging has about 97 items and staging about 62 (counts only); the waitlist/contact items must be preserved or exported before cutover.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done 2026-10-15: intake lives in the marketing stack in the production AWS account (website repo PR 24 merged, reviewed with 3 fixes): ChatticusMarketing with its own intake Lambda, DynamoDB table and SES. Apex chattic.us and www are served from it; outage about 7 minutes 17:10-17:17 UTC; 2 items migrated; leads are recorded. Limit: SES production access was DENIED (sandbox), so confirmation emails reach only verified recipients; appeal tracked separately. Legacy intake resources are unused but not deleted; retirement tracked separately.

right_now_summary: Marketing intake now runs in its own AWS stack; two items migrated, but SES reaches only verified recipients.
